description: TripPocket plans domestic trips across South Korea. Ask in plain language and it searches real attractions, recommends regions and travel courses, builds day-by-day itineraries, and answers weather, festival, and transport-cost questions using TripPocket's curated Korea travel data. It supports family, couple, solo, and barrier-free / stroller / pet-friendly / low-walking travel conditions. All places, hours, prices, and scores come from TripPocket's backend — nothing is invented.
